{{Character class |name = Ranger |flavour_text = }} [[Image:ranger_select.jpg|thumb|The Exiled Ranger]] The '''Ranger''' is Path of Exile's pure [[dexterity]] [[Character class|class]], which befits her slim and graceful appearance. She is agile and fast, darting in and out of combat to deliver vicious [[Critical Strikes|critical strikes]] that often fell her enemies in a single blow. Her natural quickness grants her a profound ability to [[Evasion|avoid damage]] through a high Evasion, and she tends to garb herself in light leathers and cloth. She has tremendous proficiency with [[Bows|ranged weapons]], but she is as lethal as any man on the battlefield with a sword. The equipment associated with the Ranger's dexterity are [[Helmet#Leather_and_Pelt_Hats_.28Evasion.29|Caps/Hoods]], [[Chest_Armour#Evasion_Chests_.28Dexterity.29|Leather/Garbs/Tunics]], [[Gloves#Evasion_Gloves_.28Dexterity.29|Hide Gloves]], [[Boots#Evasion_Boots_.28Dexterity.29|Hide Boots]], and [[Shield#Bucklers|Bucklers]]. ==Base stats== {|class="wikitable" |- !Stat !Value |- |[[Intelligence]] |14 |- |[[Dexterity]] |32 |- |[[Strength]] |14 |- |[[Life]] |57 |- |[[Mana]] |47 |- |[[Damage#Physical_Damage|Damage per second]] |3.9 |- |[[Accuracy#Mechanics|Chance to hit]] |92% |- |[[Attack_Speed|Attacks per second]]* |1.2 |- |[[Damage|Main hand total combined damage]] |2-5 |- |[[Damage#Physical_Damage|Main hand physical damage]] |2-5 |- |[[Accuracy|Main hand accuracy rating]] |64 |- |[[Critical_Strike#Critical_Strike_Damage_Multiplier|Main hand critical strike damage multiplier]]* |150% |- |[[Endurance_Charge|Endurance charges]]* |0/3 |- |Physical damage reduction per endurance charge* |4% |- |Additional elemental reduction per endurance charge* |4% |- |[[Frenzy_Charge|Frenzy charges]]* |0/3 |- |Attack speed increase per frenzy charge* |4% |- |Cast speed increase per frenzy charge* |4% |- |Damage modifier per frenzy charge* |4% more |- |[[Power_Charge|Power charges]]* |0/3 |- |Critical strike chance increase per power charge* |50% |- |[[Evasion|Evasion rating]] |15 |- |[[Evasion|Chance to evade]]* |32% |- |[[Resistances|Fire resistance]]* |0% |- |[[Resistances|Cold resistance]]* |0% |- |[[Resistances|Lightning resistance]]* |0% |- |[[Resistances|Chaos resistance]]* |0% |- |[[Mana#Mana_Regeneration|Mana regen per second]] |0.8 |} * Same for all classes as of 2.1.1d ==Ascendancy classes== Rangers can specialise into one of these three [[Ascendancy classes]]: {| style="text-align:center;" |- | [[File:Deadeye avatar.png|link=Deadeye]]

[[Pathfinder]] |} The [[Raider]] is a former Ranger Ascendancy class, which was removed in [[Version 3.25.0]]. ==Dialogue== The Ranger is voiced by New Zealand actress, [http://www.thebigidea.co.nz/news/interviews/2010/aug/73980-sophie-hambleton Sophie Hambleton]. ===Character creation=== "Swift and silent you stole the bounty of others. A crow that plunders our crops. A stray dog that slaughters our sheep. Oriath is a land of men, not animals. Think on that, Ranger, when Wraeclast shows you how to truly live like an animal." -- [[High Templar Dominus]] ===Legacy intro=== "No life can be owned. Not a deer's. Not a rabbit's. And not mine. Every creature has a birth-given right to live however it will. However it can. My right is to hunt. To feed off the wilderness in the understanding that, one day, will feed off me. The fat lords of Oriath have no such understanding. They call me 'poacher' and 'thief'. Clap me in irons and haul me like cargo into exile. No matter. I'll make the forests and mountains of Wraeclast my new home. My freedom and my bow... that's all I need." ===General Dialogue=== Achieving Level 2: "I'm still breathing: that's a good sign." Achieving Level 3: "The worms will have to wait a bit longer for this meal." Achieving Level 5: "Pain brings strength. That's nature for you." Achieving Level 10: "As the prey grows more fierce, so must the Huntress." Achieving Level 15: "One rung closer to the top of the food chain." Achieving Level 20: "Looks like this land and I are coming to an understanding." Achieving Level 30: "You've given me so much. What can I do for you, Wraeclast?" Sometimes on rare monster kill: "I give you to the earth." Sometimes on rare monster kill: "Pruning a branch can save a tree." Sometimes on rare monster kill: "I put you out of your misery." Sometimes on rare monster kill: "Beauty will grow from your remains." Sometimes on rare monster kill: "Poor, corrupted creature." Full inventory: "That would only slow me down." Using skills in town: "Can't see why I'd want to do that here." On trying to drop a quest item: "I have a hunch I'll be needing this." Out of mana: "My Mana is gone." Not enough Strength: "I'll need to toughen up for that one." Not enough Dexterity: "I need to sharpen the reflexes before I use that." Not enough Intelligence: "I'm no fool, but this one's got me beat." ===Campaign=== Entering The Prison: "There's no justice in a place like this. Only misery." Entering The Ship Graveyard: "Life and death live side by side. This is a strange land." Entering The Chamber of Sins: "Luxury and cruelty go hand in hand." On releasing the darkness: "This shouldn't be happening. Not in the world I know." Entering The Warehouse Sewers: "Life is nothing without death. That simple truth's been forgotten from time to time." Entering The Solaris Temple Level 1: "I've never felt further from what I know and love." Entering The Lunaris Temple Level 2: "Piety...you've so much to answer for." Entering The Sceptre of God: "Why do we insist on building mountains? Why not just go and climb them?" Entering The Aqueduct: "Cities are a blight upon nature, and Sarn was the foulest of them all." Entering The Dried Lake: "A lake drained, a million creatures lost, just so Sarn could keep its privies flowing." Entering The Mines Level 1: "That's no natural earthquake." Entering The Mines Level 2: "Feels like something stirring in its sleep." On freeing Deshret's spirit: "My gift, from one fighting woman to another, Deshret." Entering The Crystal Veins: "This one deeply troubled mountain." Entering Kaom's Dream: "This isn't the Karui that I know." Entering The Belly of the Beast: "So this is what life inside of a nightmare looks like." Entering The Harvest: "Every crime against nature imaginable." Killed Brutus: "I've done for you what I would do for any wounded animal, Brutus." Killed Fairgraves: "You were a good man in a bad situation, Fairgraves." Killed Merveil: "Your love for a man...that's what did this to you, Merveil." Killed Kraityn: "The king of rats? A feast for rats now." Killed Alira: "I hate to pluck a pretty flower. Even a poisonous one like you." Killed Oak: "Do some good for once in your sorry life, bandit. Feed the worms." Killed Vaal Oversoul: "Spread the word amongst your kind, nightmare. You're not welcome in my world." Killed Gravicius: "Without men like you, Gravicius, this land might just start healing itself." Killed Piety: "Your death doesn't fix anything, Piety. But at least it won't get any worse." Killed Dominus: "Some of us live to regret our mistakes. Some of us don't. Try not to take it personally." Killed Voll: "This land won't miss your kind, Voll." Killed Kaom: "One less little angry boy for the world to deal with." Killed Daresso: "The only love you had Daresso, was for yourself." Killed Shavronne: "We destroy so much beauty in our pursuit of 'prettiness'" Killed Doedre: "You were your own worse enemy, Doedre." Killed Maligaro: "Your kind leave nothing but scars, Maligaro." Killed Malachai: "You were going to put to death the world that I love. Do you really think I would let you and your Beast do that, Malachai?" ====Unique NPC Dialogue==== '''Nessa's Introduction:''' "I've seen you before, back in Oriath! Running like a frightened rabbit from my father and his gamekeepers. Fleet as a fox you were, even with that leg of prize venison over your shoulder. And from what I saw you do to Hillock, you've grown even faster since then. I'm Nessa, and I suppose I should thank you for ridding us of that putrid giant. I hope your speed never fails you, Ranger. It's all that stands between you and death, here in Wraeclast." '''Bestel's introduction:''' A ravishing Ranger, relegated to rot in Wraeclast. That's the first line of the poem I'm writing about you, exile. Easy, girl. You could skewer a bloke with a look like that. The name's Bestel, captain of the good ship 'Merry Gull'. Alas, my Merry Gull is gone. My crew is gone. But my wits remain... after a fashion." '''Maramoa's introduction:''' "You have the walk, the grace, of a woman who knows Death intimately. Men are born with that knowledge. We have to earn it. Yes, there's much that you and I might speak of but we have not the time now." '''Kira's introduction:''' "This land is a wounded animal, its torn flesh infected by Nightmare. Before you put this animal out of its misery, be sure, Ranger, to give thought to those who live on its back." '''Petarus and Vanja's introduction:''' * Vanja: "It's one thing to watch in awe as the she-wolf hunts, quite another to invite her to share your campfire. Wouldn't you agree, Ranger?" * Petarus: "No, she wouldn't, Vanja, and neither do I." * Vanja: "We both saw what she did in Sarn!" * Petarus: "And we both know that Piety and the rest had it coming!" * Vanja: "Fine, Petarus, fine." '''Tasuni's introduction:''' "Yours is a lonely existence, Ranger. The journey of the one natural beast left to this land. The corrupted wilderness rejects your love, and the corrupted creatures continue to fall to your rage." '''Oyun's introduction:''' "Although we two were born lands and cultures apart, I recognise a woman in kind. A woman who fights not only for her own survival, but for the survival of the wilderness she calls home. Yet, you are not bound like us, to the thoughts and habits of tradition. That is why you will kill the Beast within the mountain. Lady Dialla has told me this. She has much faith in you, Ranger. The question is... can we Maraketh share in her faith?" '''Piety (Chamber of Sin):''' "You again? Well, I'm sure you won't be looking so calm once that monstrosity tears you a new orifice." '''Piety (Crematorium):''' "Huntress, you are beatific because you answer to no-one. And that's why no-one will miss you." '''Gravicius:''' "God gave this world to Man, not to you, little girl!" '''Dominus:''' "It is woman's purpose to tempt and try the will of man." '''Piety, the Abomination, in the Belly of the Beast:''' "You see what happens when you hunt dreams, Ranger?" '''Piety, the Abomination, after being defeated:''' "You've just earned yourself some bigger prey, huntress." '''Piety, after being restored:''' "Listen carefully, Ranger, as this is something you will never hear from me again: I was wrong and you were right. When we shared our 'moment' back in the Lunaris, part of me wishes I'd died at your feet as intended. The little girl within me that shies from darkness, from greatness." '''Piety opening the Black Core:''' "I remember when we first crossed paths in Axiom Prison. Logic dictated that you, a feral little girl of the wild, were to die under Brutus' bloody fists. You've proven logic wrong, time and again. Now here you are. Here we are. Defying logic one last time." '''Malachai's introduction:''' "I admire you in this moment, Ranger. You and I will create the most beautiful of Nightmares together. Creation... usually the concern of Nature, isn't it? Not anymore." '''Piety's last words:''' "You... you were born for this. But you've always known that, haven't you. I've strived my whole life to make something better, of the world, of myself. You have simply lived, and the irony is, that's all that either of us ever needed to to. So go, finish the hunt, Ranger. Do what comes so naturally to you." '''Responding to Piety:''' "Piety, you never should have resisted Death. Nature will it, like all else." == Version History == The Ranger class was previously known as the "Hunter" class. {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * The Ranger and Scion have received audio dialogue for Part Two of Path of Exile. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.1| * Fixed a client crash that occurs when playing near Templars or Rangers. }} {{Version history table row|0.5.13| * Renamed Hunter class to Ranger. }} {{Version history table row|0.5.7| * Hunter (Ranger) now has some alternate attack animations }} {{Version history table row|0.5.6| * Set allowed characters to Marauder/Hunter (Ranger). }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Characters}} {{Sister|poe2wiki}}
